subject: maths
title: Time and Measurement - Clocks, Capacity and Tools

steps.title: Clocks and containers

options.label: The long hand points to twelve. What time is shown?
Now the long hand points to six. What time is shown?
Each dot stands for one cup of water. Which container holds most?

steps.hint: Use the short hand for the hour after finding the long hand on twelve.
steps.explanation: Read the long hand first and compare how much containers hold.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Clocks and containers
mathWorkshop.goal: Read the long hand first and compare how much containers hold.

tasks.prompt: The long hand points to twelve. What time is shown?
tasks.feedback: Long hand on twelve means o'clock; the short hand points to three.
tasks.hint: Use the short hand for the hour after finding the long hand on twelve.

tasks.prompt: Now the long hand points to six. What time is shown?
tasks.feedback: The hour hand is past three but not yet four. It is half past three.
tasks.hint: Read the hour it has gone past, not the next hour.

tasks.prompt: Each dot stands for one cup of water. Which container holds most?
tasks.feedback: The jug holds five cups, more than the bowl's four or the mug's two.
tasks.hint: Compare the number of same-size cups, not the height of the containers.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: O'clock
steps.prompt: What time does this clock show?
steps.hint: Look at the long hand first, then the short hand.
steps.explanation: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 4.
steps.shortExplanation: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 4.

steps.title: Half past
steps.prompt: What time does this clock show?
steps.hint: The long hand on 6 means half past. Where is the short hand?
steps.explanation: The long hand is on 6. The short hand is between 7 and 8.
steps.shortExplanation: The long hand is on 6. The short hand is between 7 and 8.

steps.title: Nine o'clock
steps.hint: At o'clock, the long hand points to 12.
steps.explanation: At 9 o'clock the long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 9.
steps.shortExplanation: At 9 o'clock the long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 9.

source.answerKeyText: Long (minute) hand pointing to 12, short (hour) hand pointing to 9.

steps.title: Clock hands
steps.prompt: What is the long hand called?
steps.hint: Which hand moves quickly around the clock?

steps.title: Measuring tools
steps.prompt: Match each measuring job to its tool.
steps.hint: What do we measure: length, weight or water?
steps.explanation: A ruler measures length, scales measure mass, and a jug measures water.
steps.shortExplanation: A ruler measures length, scales measure mass, and a jug measures water.

source.answerKeyText: pencil → ruler; flour → scales; water → jug

steps.title: Holds the most
steps.prompt: Jug holds 5 cups, bowl 4 and mug 2. Put them in order, holds most first.
steps.hint: Compare how many cups each one holds.
steps.explanation: Compare capacity: 5 cups, then 4 cups, then 2 cups.
steps.shortExplanation: Compare capacity: 5 cups, then 4 cups, then 2 cups.

steps.title: Lunchtime
steps.prompt: Lunch is at half past 12. Which clock shows lunchtime?
steps.hint: Half past: the long hand points to 6.
steps.explanation: Half past 12: the long hand points to 6, the short hand between 12 and 1.
steps.shortExplanation: Half past 12: the long hand points to 6, the short hand between 12 and 1.

source.answerKeyText: Any real lunchtime shown correctly as o'clock or half past.

steps.title: The long hand at half past
steps.prompt: At half past, the long hand points to 6.
steps.hint: Halfway around the clock, where is the long hand?
steps.explanation: The minute hand has travelled halfway around the clock.
steps.shortExplanation: The minute hand has travelled halfway around the clock.

steps.title: 3 o'clock
steps.prompt: At 3 o'clock the long hand points to...
steps.hint: At any o'clock, where is the long hand?
steps.explanation: At o'clock the long hand always points to 12.
steps.shortExplanation: At o'clock the long hand always points to 12.

steps.title: Half past 5
steps.prompt: At half past 5 the short hand is...
steps.hint: After half an hour, has the short hand reached 6 yet?
steps.explanation: At half past 5 the short hand is halfway to 6.
steps.shortExplanation: At half past 5 the short hand is halfway to 6.

steps.title: Weighing
steps.hint: Which tool shows how heavy something is?
steps.explanation: Scales show how heavy a parcel is.
steps.shortExplanation: Scales show how heavy a parcel is.

steps.title: Capacity
steps.prompt: A container that holds more has a bigger...
steps.hint: What word means how much a container holds?
steps.explanation: Capacity means how much a container can hold.
steps.shortExplanation: Capacity means how much a container can hold.

steps.title: Half an hour
steps.hint: One hour is 60 minutes. What is half of 60?
steps.explanation: An hour is 60 minutes, so half an hour is 30.
steps.shortExplanation: An hour is 60 minutes, so half an hour is 30.

stickers.meaning: How much a container can hold.

homeActivities.text: Make a paper clock with an adult handling the scissors. Practise o'clock and half past. Guess how many same-size cups fill a container, then measure at the sink.
homeActivities.textAr: اعملوا ساعة من الورق، والكبير هو اللي يمسك المقص. اتمرّنوا على الساعة بالظبط والساعة ونص. وخمّنوا كام كوباية بنفس الحجم تملا علبة، وبعدين قيسوا عند الحوض.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
